meta.title: Sell your prompts
meta.description: Turn the prompt you refined into a listing other developers can buy. You set the price, and every sale pays you.

hero.title: You already wrote something other developers would love.
hero.lead: That CLAUDE.md you tuned over dozens of sessions, the Cursor rule your whole team relies on, the agent playbook that finally just works: it saves hours for people who haven’t written it yet. We’d be glad to help you share it.
hero.mailSubject: I’d like to sell a prompt on mdstore
hero.note: No audience or store needed. Just the file.

benefits.title: Everything is set up so your work gets noticed
benefits.lead: You focus on the prompt. mdstore gives it a proper home.

ownPrice.title: You set the price
ownPrice.text: Free or paid, it’s your call. A free file is also a great way to introduce yourself.

paidPerSale.title: Paid on every sale
paidPerSale.text: Each time someone buys your file, you earn from it. Write it once, keep earning.

freePreview.title: A preview that sells for you
freePreview.text: You choose how many opening lines buyers can read for free, so the quality of your writing does the convincing.

outputExamples.title: Show what it produces
outputExamples.text: Add screenshots of the results your prompt gets. Buyers trust what they can see.

updates.title: Updates reach every buyer
updates.text: Improve your file whenever you like. People who bought it receive the new versions.

listing.title: Small and specific beats big and vague
listing.lead: You don’t need a masterpiece. A prompt that does one job well is exactly what buyers are looking for.

oneJob.title: Pick one narrow job
oneJob.text: “Improve the UX of a form” is easier to trust, and to buy, than “make my whole app better”.

testedTools.title: Say what you tested it with
testedTools.text: List the AI tools you used it with, such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, so buyers know it works.

technologies.title: Name the technologies
technologies.text: Frameworks, languages and styling approaches it supports help the right developers find it.

results.title: Keep a few results handy
results.text: A screenshot or two of what the prompt built is the strongest way to show it’s worth it.

write.title: Say hello
write.text: Email us the prompt, or just a description of it, and the tools you tested it with.

talk.title: We’ll get back to you
talk.text: Seller onboarding is in early access, so we’ll reply personally with the next steps.

publish.title: Go live
publish.text: Set your price and your preview, and your prompt is ready for developers to find.

closing.title: Not sure it’s good enough? Send it anyway.
closing.text: If it made your own work easier, it will make someone else’s easier too. Every prompt in the store started as a file like yours.
